subject: Request: interim credit bridge for 72h throughput POC
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@brightcart.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Theresa Wong <theresa@brightcart.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — 72h throughput run, need interim credits

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency profile on your Dedicated nodes. We’re ready to run a 72-hour throughput soak (spike + soak windows) starting this Friday to validate end-to-end latency and KV cache behavior under steady QPS.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provision a short-term credit bridge / sandbox top-up to cover the extra token/throughput usage? We estimate ~120k request tokens per hour during the peak window (see attached load plan).
- If helpful, we can limit to a non-production VPC and sign a brief addendum for billing neutrality for the POC.

We’re on a tight schedule: kickoff Fri 8/6 00:00 UTC. Can you confirm by EOD Wednesday?

Attachments: brightcart-72h-loadplan.yaml (text/yaml)

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, BrightCart
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 72h throughput run, need interim credits

Samir —

Appreciate the clear plan and timeline. We can support the 72-hour soak but will need an interim sandbox/top-up approval to cover the peak window. I’ve attached a short checklist below outlining our standard POC safety-net:

- Sandbox/VPC scoping confirmed (non-prod)
- Token cap and end date (we normally set an auto-expire after 72h)
- Billing addendum for POC (neutral) or committed spend if you prefer

I’m looping in Ben for approval on the promotional buffer and Marissa for ops scheduling. Ben/Marissa — any objections to a 72h, fixed-quantum credit bridge for BrightCart starting 2026-08-06 UTC? Estimated usage ~8.6M tokens total (peak windows included).

If approved, I’ll provision the sandbox top-up and send a short DocuSign addendum for Theresa to sign.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 72h throughput run, need interim credits

Olga —

Thanks for the context. Approve a one-time promotional buffer for BrightCart:
- Quantity: equivalent to 9M tokens (rounded up to 9.5M for safety)
- Window: 2026-08-06 00:00 UTC — 2026-08-09 00:00 UTC (auto-expire)
- Conditions: POC-only, non-prod VPC, billing addendum required.

Marissa — pls confirm ops can reserve the Dedicated pool (two p4d-like instances) for those dates and set auto-alerts if KV cache hit rate drops below 70%.

Jonas, I flagged RDW-2175 in HubSpot for tracking.

Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 72h throughput run, need interim credits

Ben/Olga —

Confirmed — I’ll reserve the Dedicated pool and seed the endpoint with the KV warmup script the customer provided. Ops notes:
- Instance reservation: 2 x p4d-equivalent, pinned for the window.
- Alerting: latency > 120ms P50 or KV hitrate < 70% triggers an immediate page to the on-call infra team.
- Runbook: we’ll attach a short checklist and a telemetry dashboard link to the HubSpot deal.

I’ll also upload the proposed topology and a preflight checklist to Drive and share the link once ready.

Attachments: qps-heatmap-evening.png (image/png)

-Marissa
From: Samir Patel <samir@brightcart.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Theresa Wong <theresa@brightcart.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 72h throughput run, need interim credits

Perfect — thanks, team. We accept the 9.5M token promotional buffer and the POC addendum. Theresa, I’ve asked procurement to expect the DocuSign. Olga, please send the DocuSign link and any quick instructions for the non-prod VPC setup.

I’ve attached a final version of the load plan and the proposed ramp schedule. We’ll standby for the provisioning confirmation.

Attachments: proposed-quote-v2.pdf (application/pdf), brightcart-72h-loadplan.yaml (text/yaml)

Samir
BrightCart — Head of Platform Engineering
